source: IMD seasonal rainfall vs Long Period Average (https://mausam.imd.gov.in/) via https://data.gov.in/
note: SEED pack. `value` is the latest cumulative-monsoon departure from the Long Period Average (a rural-demand / agri-input proxy); refresh from IMD/data.gov.in with scripts/refresh_macro.py --kind monsoon before relying on the magnitude. `neutral` 0 means exactly-normal rainfall maps to a zero nudge. `sector_sensitivity` is a maintained crosswalk of rural-demand exposure (0..1; NSE-Industry + yfinance) and is never touched by a fetch. tailwind = clamp(((value-neutral)/MONSOON_SCALE) * sensitivity, -1, 1). Not investment advice.
